what: Ram Charge + Rocket Salvo one-shots a full Arcanist
detail: Ram 400 kinetic + 3 x 180 rockets = 940 raw vs Arcanist 380/420: DOWN. The judge required fix (Arcanist 500 or Ram x0.75 vs ships) is not applied (420, Ram 400); use RAM_VS_SHIP 0.625 as Sortie does.

what: Ram Charge + Rocket Salvo one-shots a full Arcanist
detail: Ram 400 kinetic + 3 x 180 rockets = 940 raw vs Arcanist 380/500: DOWN. The judge required fix (Arcanist 500 or Ram x0.75 vs ships) is only half applied (500 but Ram unscaled vs ships); use RAM_VS_SHIP 0.625 as Sortie does.

what: EMP Pulse is un-counterable inside its radius
detail: r420 with a 0.35 s tell: from the centre nobody can leave (needs ~1200 px/s). It zeroes shields, drains 40% power and blocks regen 2 s; a point-blank Jugg MD then takes an Arcanist down in 0.58 s. Counterplay is only pre-emptive spacing; consider r340 (Arcade/Sortie) or a 0.6 s tell.

what: Hyperlance spool can track
detail: Spool 0.45 s along the live aim: a Juggernaut at rest needs 0.58 s (reaction + 34 px of thrust) to leave a locked line, and nothing can leave a tracking one. Lock the rail direction at spool start (or turn-rate cap ~1 rad/s) so "react to the line" is real counterplay.

what: Hyperlance charge tracks at turn x0.5
detail: Rooted 1.0 s with turn x0.5 (Arcanist 16 rad/s -> 8 rad/s) tracks anything; 650 per ship and 2500 x pveScale per enemy pierce-all at 2600 px. Lock the aim for the last 0.5 s of the charge.

what: Drone Carrier counterplay fails
detail: "shoot the drones": Arca LZ is taken down at 1.8 s while clearing (7.2 s to clear); Arti PH is taken down at 2.6 s while clearing (6.7 s to clear). 6 drones = 540 kinetic dps within 550 px for 10 s, i.e. a second point-blank Mass Driver that auto-aims. Cut drone dps vs ships (x0.4) or drone count to 4.

what: Drone Carrier counterplay fails
detail: "shoot the drones": Arca LZ is taken down at 3.0 s while clearing (4.8 s to clear). 6 drones = 432 kinetic dps within 450 px for 12 s, i.e. a second point-blank Mass Driver that auto-aims. Cut drone dps vs ships (x0.4) or drone count to 4.

what: Wrecking Run re-hit loop
detail: Impacts allow one hit per target per 0.5 s and stagger lasts 0.6 s; at 900 px/s and turn 6 rad/s the run loops back in ~1.05 s (150 px radius), so a staggered target is hit 2-3 times in the 3 s run: 2 hits + shockwave take down a full Arcanist, 3 hits a full Artificer (the spec checks only 1 hit). Make it once per target per run (or stagger 0.3 s).

what: Ult castable in brownout
detail: Q ignores brownout (only EMP blocks it): brown out on purpose, then ult. Hero and Sortie block Q in brownout.

what: Rampage contact cap
detail: contacts limited to once per 0.5 s per target -> up to 10 x 160 = 1600 raw on one ship in 5 s while CC-immune; 3 contacts leave a full Arcanist at 0/494 but 5+ take it down. Cap at 3 hits per target per run (like Carpet Bomb).

what: Event Horizon owner is the glass cannon
detail: Hero puts the ship-centred black hole on the Arcanist (380/420): parked alone it eats ~21.0 kamikaze contacts in 5 s (1186 dmg on floor 3, 148% of its EHP) plus the pulled swarm; the other two kits give EH to the Juggernaut (armor 0.4 + Polarize).

what: Gravity Well (E) traps the Jugg
detail: the E well pulls hostile ships at the full well pull (live stepWell, uniform): base 900 px/s^2 for 3 s lets out after 2.13 s the Jugg; Void + Deep Well (1350, r364, 5 s) holds it the whole 5 s even boosting (CR Jugg thrust 620, x1.5 boost = 930). A 6.5-10 s-cooldown SPECIAL out-pulls the Event Horizon ultimate (260-300 on ships). Cap well ship pull at ~300 or apply Sortie's SHIP_PULL_CAP.
